## Software package metadata

Search 19 software package ecosystems from SQL: npm, PyPI, crates.io, Maven Central, NuGet, RubyGems, Go, Conda, Homebrew formulae and casks, APT, RPM, Alpine, pinned nixpkgs, Packagist, pub.dev, Hex, CRAN, Bioconductor and pinned vcpkg. Read native versions, artifacts and dependency declarations. Use sources, capabilities and source_status for discovery; prepare indexed sources using bin/vgi-software-index. vcpkg versions use upstream#port-revision (omit revision zero); its historical version inventory is available, but dependency declarations describe only the pinned snapshot's current ports. Authentication is optional and source-scoped. Container images have a separate containers worker. Starter example functions remain available for compatibility. All objects are in schema main. The sources table lists configured source_id, ecosystem, endpoint and search_mode (`VARCHAR`), plus credential_configured (`BOOLEAN`). The capabilities table lists source_id and operation (`VARCHAR`), supported (`BOOLEAN`), searched_fields and scope descriptions. The source_status table reports ready/complete/stale (`BOOLEAN`), records (`BIGINT`), and snapshot/revision identifiers (`VARCHAR`); native-source readiness does not perform a network probe. These three tables also have zero-argument table-function forms. search(source_id `VARCHAR`, query `VARCHAR`, max_results `BIGINT`) returns native name, version and description (`VARCHAR`), nullable provider score (`DOUBLE`), and indexed coverage. package(source_id `VARCHAR`, package_name `VARCHAR`) returns name, version, homepage, repository and license (`VARCHAR`). versions(source_id `VARCHAR`, package_name `VARCHAR`) returns native version and published_at (`VARCHAR`), plus nullable yanked (`BOOLEAN`). artifacts(source_id `VARCHAR`, package_name `VARCHAR`, version `VARCHAR`) returns filename, url, hashes JSON text, artifact_type (`VARCHAR`) and nullable size (`BIGINT`). dependencies(source_id `VARCHAR`, package_name `VARCHAR`, version `VARCHAR`) returns dependency, requirement, kind, condition and declaration_context (`VARCHAR`). All package result sets include source_id, ecosystem and observation time; metadata is nullable sanitized JSON text. All query functions are table functions with positional source/name/query/version inputs. Search requires an explicit positional max_results; the other query functions accept named max_results with default 1000. Limits must be 1 through 10000. Arguments must be literals (no LATERAL column references); combine operations by joining separate calls, for example package to versions on version or two dependencies calls on dependency. Empty search strings and empty package names are rejected. Artifact and dependency queries require an exact native version from versions(). Missing upstream metadata remains SQL NULL. Result row order is not a version ordering; use explicit ORDER BY for deterministic presentation.

### Usage

Discover configured sources, prepare any required index, then query search, package, versions, artifacts and dependencies. The separate container worker provides OCI image inspection.
